name: Pre-built local weekly trivia packs for independent venues
buyer: Independent bar, pub or restaurant manager, or a freelance trivia host
pain: Writing questions, slides and scoring each week. A pricing guide says DIY costs 4-6 staff hours per night, and the same guides note that few venues sustain it.
wedge: Weekly packs localized to the venue (city events, the venue's name and menu), delivered pre-slid and pre-scored, at $20-29/month. The notes call it weak because the local angle is unproven and Trivia Flow and Trivnow already sit at $25-29.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Pre-built local slides and scoring sheets generated by automation, so venue staff only run the night (under 15 minutes per week of prep, an owner estimate). The 4-hour incumbent figure is the low end of the cited DIY range.
scan1Edge.falsifier: Existing pack sellers already ship ready-made handouts and slides (C15, C17), so if venues see no prep difference versus those products, there is no edge.
scan1Edge.unit: venue staff hours per trivia night

substitutesNoted.name: Trivia Flow
substitutesNoted.price_point: Free tier; Premium $29/month (owner notes, not in a listed excerpt)

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: Model: $25/month subscription, ~75% margin per the owner's estimate. Churn is likely high because venues drop trivia nights.

majorUncertainty: Whether venues will pay for a 'local' pack over $0-29 alternatives, and whether a founder with no network can reach them.
unknowns: Whether the local angle changes purchase behaviour
Copyright treatment of image and audio rounds
Trivia Flow Premium $29 price is in the notes but not in a listed excerpt
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: No platform dependency. Question accuracy and copyright matter, and image or audio rounds raise rights questions.
